title: reflect.fm
tagline: A blazing fast decentralized podcast page for all existing podcasts
description:
We saw that existing "podcast pages" suffer from slow page loads, centralized infrastructure, and bad SEO. This makes them less accessible to developing communities around the world.

Reflect.fm fixes this with a decentralized podcast page with better speed, SEO, and readability than any podcast page in the world. Best of all, it's interoperable with existing podcast providers, so you already have a page on reflect.fm if you have a podcast!

Anyone who uses Anchor, Libsyn, or has an RSS feed can use reflect.fm today!
how_its_made: We built this to be unstoppable with IPFS. In addition, we pulled in advanced web2 technologies like Next.js and TypeScript. With the help of https://bundlephobia.com, we made tactical choices around every line of code completed. This means that a podcast page has better speed, SEO, and readability than any "podcast page" that exists in the world.
